aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:869.title: UI Designer
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:869.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary Working from existing Company brand and style guides, the UI Designer will create art and digital assets used for national and local campaigns and for web and mobile projects across AEG Presents' brands, tours, and festivals. The Designer takes tasks and projects through successful completion by creating user-interface design collateral, diagnosing design issues and setbacks, and proposing viable solutions. This individual excels at time management, can tend to multiple tasks and projects depending on demand, and has a firm understanding of all levels of Production. Essential Functions Carry user-interface design projects from concept through completion for website, mobile app, and other asset needs across the Company. Provide expertise on user-interface design by brainstorming, ideating, and advising designers to create conceptual designs that communicate key messages effectively, while adhering to brand guidelines of the Company and its entities. Ensure internal web and mobile user-interface design consistency across the organization by collaborating with marketers and other designers, documenting best practices, and organizing design files and working folders to promote team efficiency and synergy. Maintain current knowledge on industry and design trends (with a focus on user-interface design) to keep the team at the industry’s forefront in content and design spaces. Required Qualifications BA/BS Degree (4-year) in Art, Design or related field 2-4 years of digital creative design experience (e.g., in UX/UI) Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, InDesign and Illustrator and Microsoft Office Strong understanding of web optimization and digital file types Experience creating digital collateral (i.e., Websites, mobile apps, banners, social media assets, outdoor, etc.) Strong communication and organizational skills and proven ability to communicate effectively with nondesigners on projects Must be organized, detail-oriented and able to multi-task and work in a fast-paced high-pressure environment Self-starter, able to think creatively to solve problems Strong knowledge and interest in design and demonstrated ability to think creatively Commitment to continuous learning and personal development Knowledge of music industry preferred Payscale: $96,611.00 - $150,000 Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings. cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:61.title: Diesel Technician
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:61.description: Our client is looking for a Diesel Mechanic, the primary purpose of this position is to provide basic mechanical, repair, maintenance, and other related services to the customers. This person must have a clear understanding of routine and complex truck and trailer repair processes, routine maintenance tasks, shop techniques and practices, parts, materials and the operation, use, and basic repair of basic shop equipment. Performs assigned duties and tasks to meet Company standards and customer satisfaction. This position reports to the Shop Supervisor but may receive work instructions for specific assignments from a lead mechanic or technician. This position impacts the profitability of the Company by working efficiently, not wasting time on the job, not wasting parts and materials, not breaking tools needlessly, and not creating rework.
responsibilities: Assists Mechanics with completing complex mechanical truck and trailer service, maintenance, and repairs, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers, including, but not limited to working with the following mechanical systems: engine, electrical, drive train, tire, steering, suspension, refrigeration units, etc.
Performs vehicle and trailer inspections according to DOT standards and understands what is necessary to bring identified basic deficiencies into compliance.

Performs routine and complex vehicle fluid and filter checks and replacements.  Checks these systems according to manufacturer’s specifications and replaces fluids and filters with appropriate materials and according to company standards.

Conducts routine vehicle and trailer electrical inspections.  Makes routine replacements of fuses, bulbs, batteries, etc.  Makes routine and complex electrical repairs, installations and replacements.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for engine and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for electrical and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for wheel, tire, axle and related systems.
Informs Supervisor regarding problems or difficulties encountered during troubleshooting repair or maintenance procedures.  Discusses any problems, complaints, requests, or ideas with the Supervisor.
Assists the Shop Supervisor with training other mechanics working in the shop.

Assists with managing the stock and equipment inventories as assigned to the shop.  Takes and reports physical counts of stock inventory according to schedule established by the Shop Supervisor.  Notifies Shop Supervisor when stock inventories are approaching reorder points.
Notifies Shop Supervisor in a timely manner when non-stock parts are needed on a maintenance job so that the parts can be ordered quickly and not significantly delay the job’s scheduled completion.
Assists with the training of other technical staff as assigned by answering questions and showing by example.
May be required to cover the shop operations in the event of a vacation or absence of the Shop Supervisor.
Completes all necessary paperwork and reports accurately and submits in a timely manner.
Responsible for keeping assigned company tools available and undamaged at all times, which will include Company assigned tablet.

Will be required to utilize shop software on a daily basis which includes: creating jobs, clocking in and out of jobs, accurately entering all parts used on jobs, and entering all notes efficiently and thoroughly.
qualifications: Requires valid current Iowa driver’s license.
Employee must have the ability to drive all types of trucks, including manual transmissions.
Three to five years of experience with diesel truck repair is preferred, but 2 years of experience is required.
Employee must have the ability to consistently present him/herself and the company to the public in a clean, courteous, and professional manner.
Employee must work professionally and be respectful of all other employees of this company.
Employee must be able to lift up to 100 lbs.
Employee must have the ability to write a work order.
All employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment drug test.
Employee understands all employees must submit to random drug/alcohol testing if they are randomly selected throughout the year, at no cost to the employee.
Requires mechanical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read technical diagrams and manuals.

interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:05619757-152.title: Cofounder + CEO, Industrial Bottleneck Intelligence
interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:05619757-152.description: LOCATION Full Time, Remote JOB DESCRIPTION Our Studio is the division of Interplay that builds new companies from scratch. We come up with ideas internally, diligence them hard and when we can’t kill them... we build them. We are seeking a Cofounder & CEO to lead the launch and growth of a new venture focused on Industrial Bottleneck Intelligence. You will be responsible for taking the concept from a validated idea to a scaled production powerhouse. While you run the entire company, Interplay provides the institutional "back-office" to help you succeed. Interplay is a startup ecosystem that supports founders via venture capital, an accelerator, a studio, a platform of core business services, and a multi-family office. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead the development of a new company. - Define company strategy & vision. - Develop the go-to-market strategy and operational model. - Recruit the team. - Raise capital. - Scale. PREFERRED SKILLS - Have built a company before. - Laugh (often). - Have a great attitude and are willing to get your hands dirty. - Are willing to run through brick walls without a helmet. - Love problem solving and winning - Have relevant industry experience. - Have direct experience building or commercializing data, analytics, market-intelligence, alternative-data, supply-chain, industrial-research, or AI-enabled intelligence products. - Are credible with hedge funds, public-market investors, asset managers, private equity firms, venture investors, corporate strategy teams, and other sophisticated buyers of investment intelligence. - Understand one or more relevant domains such as defense, industrials, energy infrastructure, grid equipment, semiconductors, critical materials, advanced manufacturing, logistics, or supply-chain risk. - Have demonstrated experience raising institutional or venture capital; prior leadership in a successfully exited VC-backed company is strongly preferred. - Are hyper-organized. - Have the ability to work well in an unstructured environment. - Bachelor’s degree is required, MBA is a plus. - Minimum of 5 years of work experience.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:25d1273e-8045-.title: Senior Back End Engineer - Sportsbook
jobgether-jobgether:lever:25d1273e-8045-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Back End Engineer – Sportsbook based in Spain. This is a senior engineering opportunity to help build a brand-new Sportsbook platform from the ground up. You will play a key role in shaping the backend architecture, technical foundations, and engineering practices behind a global gaming product. The position covers the full software development lifecycle, from understanding product requirements and system design through deployment, testing, and maintenance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to turn ambitious product ideas into scalable and reliable technical solutions. As a senior technical contributor, you will influence architectural decisions, improve system performance, and establish strong engineering standards. The environment is agile, fast-moving, and highly collaborative, offering substantial ownership over the technology being built. It is an opportunity to make a direct impact on a new Sportsbook product and help define its technical direction from day one. Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient backend services for a new Sportsbook platform. Contribute to the end-to-end development lifecycle, from framing product requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Collaborate with product, engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical specifications. Lead architectural discussions and make informed technology decisions that improve scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability. Design and implement large-scale distributed systems capable of supporting a growing gaming platform. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues across backend services and production environments. Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, testing approaches, and code-review processes. Contribute to CI/CD practices and deployment automation to support reliable and efficient software delivery. Help shape the technical roadmap and architecture of the Sportsbook as the product evolves. Requirements: Proven experience building and launching a Sports betting application from scratch, with strong understanding of the technical requirements of Sportsbook platforms. 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in Java and/or Kotlin and Spring . Demonstrated experience designing and implementing large-scale software systems, particularly distributed and highly scalable backend systems. Strong understanding of backend architecture, system design, scalability, performance, and reliability. Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-based application environments. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues independently. Ability to lead technical discussions, influence architectural decisions, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively in an agile, cross-functional environment. Good command of English, equivalent to at least B2 level . Benefits: Opportunity to build a new Sportsbook platform from the ground up and directly influence its architecture and technology. High level of technical ownership and visibility across a new product initiative. Opportunity to work on large-scale, distributed backend systems and challenging engineering problems. Collaborative and agile working environment with cross-functional teams. Ability to shape engineering standards, architectural decisions, and development practices from an early stage. Opportunity to contribute to an ambitious global gaming product and help shape its future.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c4051d2-90f7-.title: Tech Lead Fullstack (Java/React)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c4051d2-90f7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Lead Fullstack (Java/React) based in Brazil. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity for someone who combines strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to guide a development team. You will act as a key technical reference, connecting architectural direction with practical implementation across modern cloud-native systems. The role covers the full technology stack, from Java and Spring Boot backends to React frontends, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure. You will help shape technical decisions, identify risks and technical debt, and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and reliable. Working closely with architects and cross-functional teams, you will influence design while remaining close to day-to-day engineering execution. The environment emphasizes microservices, distributed systems, automation, observability, and continuous delivery. It is an ideal role for a technically mature professional who enjoys mentoring others, solving complex problems, and contributing directly to high-quality software delivery. Serve as the primary technical reference for the development team, guiding design and implementation decisions while partnering closely with solution architects. Translate business requirements and architectural direction into clear, sustainable, and executable technical solutions. Lead the development of robust fullstack solutions across Java/Spring Boot, React, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure. Guide the implementation of microservices, REST APIs, messaging, asynchronous processing, and distributed system integrations. Conduct code reviews and promote clean code, design patterns, engineering standards, and development best practices. Monitor the complete development lifecycle, from technical refinement through deployment, ensuring consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness. Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, scalability concerns, and technical debt, prioritizing improvements based on business and engineering impact. Investigate complex technical problems, conduct troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and coordinate incident and problem resolution. Contribute to architectural discussions by bringing practical implementation insights and helping evaluate technical alternatives. Mentor and technically develop team members, sharing knowledge and raising engineering standards across the team. Support CI/CD automation, deployment processes, traceability, and integration with quality and security tooling. Promote observability through effective use of logs, metrics, traces, monitoring, and diagnostic practices. Apply secure development practices, including vulnerability analysis and security considerations throughout the delivery lifecycle. Leverage AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, software quality, investigation, and the team's overall engineering capabilities. Requirements: Strong professional experience in software engineering with demonstrated technical leadership or Tech Lead responsibilities. Hands-on expertise with Java and Spring Boot , including REST APIs, microservices, messaging, asynchronous processing, and system integrations. Strong frontend development experience with React , including component architecture, state management, API integration, and frontend best practices. Fullstack perspective with the ability to understand and guide solutions end-to-end across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure. Solid knowledge of Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean-code practices . Experience with distributed systems, including synchronous and asynchronous communication, APIs, events, and service-to-service integration. Strong experience with AWS , particularly services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, S3, ECS/EKS, and other relevant cloud

jobgether-jobgether:lever:9ba57137-a588-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in United States. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in United Kingdom. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion.
